🎶 Dance all weekend to an exclusive concert from PinkPantheress

🤝 Meet your favorite BRITs Nominees and artists

Important
  - Voice chat enabled
  - Your account has to be at least 1 month old to join
  - Wins and kills do not save on VIP servers
  - No special rounds on VIP servers
  - VIP server owners receive admin commands

Products
  - To equip/unequip tags, type: /toggle
  - To equip the Spray Can, type: /spray
  - To equip/unequip the Radio, type: /radio
  - To play music, type: /play ID | To stop type: /stop
  - To use Advanced Spectate, type: /spec
